detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #21 Browser Viewport Metadata The browser window should fit the screen persona behind it. PH4NTXM derives viewport metadata from the generated display dimensions and pixel ratio. Seeded, bounded UI offsets account for the difference between a nominal screen and the area available to browser content. The completed browser environment is installed atomically for its consumers. Linux and Windows use the normal session chain, while Lone Wolf has a separate generator. Tor Browser still follows its own display policy. Generated system metadata alone does not establish that every browser-visible dimension has changed. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
